question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence. The team's performance was at its __zenith __in 2017.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Nadir**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Zenith"** means the highest point or peak of something, often used to describe the pinnacle of success or achievement. (चरम)

 
 
• **Example: **Her career reached its zenith when she won the Nobel Prize.
 
 
 
• **"Nadir"** refers to the lowest point, often used to describe a situation that is at its worst or most unsuccessful. (निम्नतम बिंदु)
 
 
• **Example: **The company hit its nadir when it declared bankruptcy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Zenith' **is **'Nadir'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Nadir**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Peak **(शिखर): The pointed top of a mountain or the highest level of something.

 
 
• **Example:** He was at the peak of his career when he retired.
 
 
 
• **Height **(ऊंचाई): The measurement from base to top or the highest level of something.
 
 
• **Example: **She is afraid of heights and avoids tall buildings.
 
 
 
• **Sneak** (चोरी-चुपके): To move quietly and secretly to avoid being noticed.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to sneak out of the house without waking anyone.
